Pinax 0.36.2, released 2026-11-27 · github.com/rubidus-api/pinax_lang Code runs when it is whole: it ends with "," or ".", and a loop or a block runs at its end. :help lists the commands; :list shows the program with its line numbers.
pinax>
ready
The program. Ctrl+S (or F2) saves it and runs it again from a fresh state; Esc leaves it unchanged.
